info.text:
Saving $416.67 a month for two years gets to $10,000, but the interest can be $385.68 or 96 cents depending only on the account. This guide walks through saving a first $10,000 step by step: setting a deadline and doing the paycheck math, finding the money with refunds and raises, the trade-off with high-interest card debt, where savings sits (FDIC insurance, money market accounts versus funds, fintech apps), automating deposits, and how interest, inflation and taxes change the result. It ends with the common mistakes and a one-screen checklist.
